description: Return bounded annual history for one official BEA SASUMMARY state or U.S. indicator. Includes exact value, unit, state GeoFIPS, pagination, source update date, evidence hash, and attribution. Use this for 'Texas real GDP since 2018', 'California per-capita income history', or 'US employment by year'. Published aggregate annual estimates only; BEA can revise prior vintages.

end_year.description: Four-digit calendar year. Hosted source coverage is reported in every response.

geography.description: State name, USPS abbreviation, 5-digit state-summary GeoFIPS, or United States/US.

indicator.description: Supported indicator slug/name or BEA SASUMMARY line code; examples: gdp, real_gdp, personal_income, per_capita_personal_income, regional_price_parities, total_employment.

response_format.description: Human-readable markdown or machine-readable JSON. Default markdown.

start_year.description: Four-digit calendar year. Hosted source coverage is reported in every response.

name: bea_state_economic_history
